headline: As of 2026-11-05: 72,080,082 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+8.0 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 72,080,082 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+8.0 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (9,394,386), Florida (8,331,371), Texas (8,173,873).
